# Mr Bubba Services

> Independent service operation offering practical web development, data cleanup, spreadsheet help, and business automation.

## Primary pages

- [Store and quote form](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/): service catalog and project quote form.
- [Bookkeeping data cleanup](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/bookkeeping-overflow.html): fixed-scope accounting and bookkeeping spreadsheet cleanup starting at $75.
- [CSV cleaner](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-csv-cleaner/): browser-based CSV cleanup demo with a paid single-file cleanup option.
- [CSV cleanup for CRM import](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/csv-cleanup-for-crm-import.html): prepare CSV or Excel exports for a cleaner CRM import, starting at $75.
- [CSV Cleaner Pro](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/csv-cleaner-pro.html): one-time $15 personal-use Python script for repeatable CSV and Excel cleanup.
- [Free tools catalog](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-free-tools/): browser-based invoice, conversion, chart, and n8n starter tools.
- [n8n CSV to Google Sheets workflow](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/n8n-csv-google-sheets.html): bounded workflow implementation starting at $150.
- [13-Week Cash Visibility Brief](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/cash-visibility-brief.html): redaction-first operational cash planning pilot from $49; not accounting, tax, legal, lending, investment, or insolvency advice.
- [Offline Roofing & Stair Calculator](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/offline-trade-calculator.html): free browser demo and preliminary local trade-calculation pilot from $12; not engineering or code-compliance advice.
- [Offline Structured-Log Explorer](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/offline-log-explorer.html): synthetic browser demo and local JSONL/CSV filtering/redaction pilot from $15; redaction is not guaranteed security or compliance.
- [Local Accessibility QA Bookmarklet](https://rngbubba.github.io/mr-bubba-store/accessibility-qa.html): local browser heuristics for common accessibility signals with a $29 price hypothesis; not a WCAG conformance audit, legal opinion, or certification.

## Services

- Data cleanup and organization: starting at $75 per file.
- Websites: starting at $299.
- Business automation: starting at $150.
- Spreadsheet templates: starting at $25.
- PDF processing and OCR: starting at $30.
- Data visualization: starting at $75.

## Contact and purchasing

Use the store's quote form to describe the work and receive a quote before paid work begins. No registration, incorporation, or licensing status is implied by this information.
